activity.text: Mobile layout (sticky image + swipeable lens chips), new fonts, hide-text toggle; pushed to GitHub Pages
Published to GitHub Pages: https://mklasen.github.io/lenses/ (repo mklasen/lenses, auto-deploys site/ on push to main)
Shipped Lens Viewer + Perspective Room, tested in browser

headline: Interactive 'swap a lens' perspective experience
summary: Lens Viewer: 3 scenes × 8 lenses (circle-of-concern powers-of-ten zoom, time horizon 1925→12,000, threat/wonder, tunnel, bubble, only-me, hurry; stackable). Perspective Room: 7 POVs (you, baby, mum, grandpa, dog, cat, fly) with eye simulations and a 'what things mean' strip.
next: Feedback round; ideas: guided walk mode, room hotspots, ambient audio, more lenses
